sections.title: Objective and Scope
paragraphs: The Work From Home (WFH) policy provides a framework for associates to work remotely while maintaining productivity and meeting business requirements. This policy applies to all full-time employees of Cotelligent who are eligible for WFH as determined by their role, project requirements, and manager approval.

sections.title: WFH Entitlement
paragraphs: Associates are eligible for a maximum of 4 WFH days per month. WFH days cannot be carried forward to the next month if unused.

WFH is not an entitlement or a right; it is a flexibility provided at the discretion of the reporting manager based on business needs. The manager may revoke WFH privileges if business requirements demand it.

sections.title: How to Apply for WFH
paragraphs: Associates must apply for WFH in advance through the ZOHO HR system. The WFH request must be submitted at least 24 hours before the intended WFH day, unless there is an emergency situation.
The request must be approved by the reporting manager before the associate begins working from home. Working from home without prior approval will be treated as unauthorized absence.

In case of emergencies (illness, urgent personal circumstances), the associate must inform the reporting manager and HR as early as possible and apply for WFH/leave in ZOHO retroactively on the same day.

sections.title: Eligibility Conditions
paragraphs: Associates in their probation period are generally not eligible for WFH unless specifically approved by the department head. Associates must have a stable internet connection and a suitable work environment at home. Associates must be reachable on all official communication channels during work hours while on WFH.
Project-specific requirements may override this policy. If a project requires full-time office presence, WFH may not be applicable regardless of the general policy.

sections.title: Responsibilities While on WFH
paragraphs: Associates working from home must: maintain regular work hours as per their shift, attend all scheduled meetings and calls, respond to messages and emails promptly, and meet daily deliverables as expected.
Associates must not engage in personal activities that interfere with work during WFH hours. The same professional conduct expected in office applies while working from home.
Associates must mark their attendance in ZOHO on WFH days. Failure to mark attendance will result in the day being treated as leave without pay.

sections.title: Exceptions and Special Circumstances
paragraphs: Extended WFH beyond 4 days per month may be approved in exceptional circumstances such as medical conditions (with supporting documentation), natural calamities or local disruptions, or specific project requirements approved by the department head.
Client-facing roles and roles requiring physical presence (infrastructure, facilities, reception) are generally not eligible for WFH.
